posts.title: Hema Bakhshi joins as Partner
paras: How do your senior leaders stay composed when the pressure is on?
Hema Bakhshi has officially joined Showing Up as a Partner, and we couldn't be more pleased.
Hema coaches founders and senior leaders. For many years she has helped them think clearly, keep calm and stay composed when the pressure is on.
At Showing Up, Hema is a Partner Facilitator and Executive Coach, and she leads two of the Nine Dimensions - Character and Collaboration.
Welcome, Hema. We're lucky to have you.

posts.title: Melanie Everett joins as Partner for Education Publishing
paras: The amazing Melanie Everett has joined our team as Partner for Education Publishing. Those who know us best know this sector means the world to us, especially through the Showing Up Foundation. Welcome to the team, Mel. We are beyond lucky to have you join us.

posts.title: Mike Morton joins as Partner and Lead Facilitator
paras: What makes a great facilitator?
It's a real pleasure to share that Mike Morton has officially joined Showing Up as a Partner and our Lead Facilitator.
Mike has facilitated learning for the world's leading firms for most of his working life, and he brings real energy, warmth and craft to every room he works in.
At Showing Up, Mike leads three of the Nine Dimensions of the Very Best Consultants: Creativity, Communication and Commercial Acumen.
Welcome, Mike. We're so glad to have you on the team.

posts.title: Beth Grayston joins as Partner
paras: We are delighted to share that Beth Grayston - ACC has joined us as a Partner at Showing Up. Our team has worked with Beth for more than a decade, and she is an exceptional facilitator and coach.
After a decade in learning and development in commercial roles, Beth decided to get more hands-on, became a coach and facilitator herself, and has been fully certified since 2019.

What Beth does best is helping people find the values and strengths that are genuinely theirs, and then building a plan they can actually get on with. At Showing Up, Beth will lead our Commercial Acumen, Collaboration and Coaching dimensions, along with our executive coaching work.
Welcome, Beth. We are very lucky to have you as part of the team.

posts.title: Our feature in Your Business with James Caan
paras: "Building the problem-solvers of the future."
That is the headline on our two-page feature in the Autumn 2026 issue of Your Business with James Caan (pages 308-309).

It is about the ingenuity gap: the growing gulf between the complexity of the problems we face and our ability to solve them. Closing it takes more than knowledge. It takes the way people think, and the character they bring when thinking is not enough.
That is the work behind the Nine Dimensions of the Very Best Consultants, and you will find them on the page.
The issue is free to read online. Link in the comments.

posts.title: Full rehearsal for Solve the International Crisis
paras: We are so honoured to be working with this remarkable team of actors and facilitators. Yesterday we did a full rehearsal at our amazing client's office in London for a two-day event we are running next week. Such an encouraging and supportive group, who are not only so dedicated to their craft, but also work together to elevate every minute of the 14.5 hours of learning that has been designed.
We will share the full overview in video form from the event, which begins with a simulation: SOLVE THE INTERNATIONAL CRISIS.
Thank you to Mike Morton Hetty Burton Morgan James Hema Bakhshi Angela Levene Beth Grayston - ACC for your brilliance

posts.title: The first Foundation scholarship goes to Kenny
paras: This is the brilliant GANZA Kenny. Kenny has received the FIRST of what we aim to be at least one million scholarships by 2035, provided by our foundation at Showing Up (link to learn more in the comments)

We first met Kenny in 2013 at Urukundo in Rwanda. He's just finished his schooling and has the heart and energy to do amazing things in the world, and he will! The scholarship gives Kenny free access to further education that will enable him to do great things in the world.
The scholarship could not be going to a more wonderful and courageous person!

posts.title: Olivia Gribaudo joins as Partner
paras: We've had the privilege of Olivia Gribaudo contributing to our client work in the past years, which is why it's beyond exciting to share the official joining of our team as a Partner.

Olivia has spent her career on the human side of change, in the belief that organisations transform when their people do. Over fifteen years at Diageo, and since then as a consultant to global organisations across financial services, technology, energy and retail, she has led everything from organisational redesign to full-scale culture change. Her gift is bringing clarity to the complex and the ambiguous. At Showing Up, Olivia leads our Character and Collaboration dimensions and our client transformation work. She speaks five European languages and loves theatre, dance, and travel. Welcome, Olivia. We are beyond lucky to have you as part of the team.
Welcome to Showing Up | Developing brilliant consulting teams.

posts.title: The learning academy at Bind Media
paras: Words will always fail to describe how great it is working with Bind Media | B-Corp. The third-best place to work in the UK (though we'd argue the first!), the team are always so welcoming, engaged, and absolutely locked in to being the very best performance marketing agency.
This was the third part of the learning academy we have developed for Bind, focused on Curiosity, Critical Thinking & Creativity.
P.S. We did more than just play with spaghetti and marshmallows, promise!

posts.title: A second free video, and the 12 traits self-assessment
paras:
The response to our first Showing Up video has been incredible. Thank you!
Here is our next free video, along with a free self-assessment 🥳 from our series, 'The 12 Traits Clients Trust Most.'
I’ve spent over 30 years in sales, starting with a car washing business with my brother when we were kids.
And I fully believe that whether you’re selling, consulting, or advising, the best people live by a set of traits that put people first.
To hold your clients in the highest regard.
To act with integrity.
And being dependable is key to that.
This series explores 12 of the traits that clients trust most, and a complementary assessment accompanies each.
Links below if you’d like to dive in 🙂 And please get in touch with me if you'd like to invest in your client-facing team's development.
Thanks again for the kind words about our first video, and take care.

posts.title: First micro-lesson: what is your white whisky?
paras: We’re excited to share our very first micro-lesson: What is your White Whisky? 🥃 This is the start of a weekly series of short, practical lessons designed for people in client-facing roles. Each one is available as both a podcast and a video, so you can learn wherever and whenever works best. To get all of this learning content, click the link in the comments, good people 🙌
This story is very much inspired by my time at Diageo and the brilliant story of Vladimir Smirnoff.
